profile.headline: Data Steward | Data Quality Analyst | IT Controls Tester | Regulatory Reporting Analyst | Knowledge Management | Business Systems Analyst | Clinical Data Analyst | TDM | Seeking Fully Remote Roles
profile.summary:
I am a Test Data Engineer and Software Engineer with experience designing automated solutions, improving data quality, and managing enterprise test data within Banking & Lending Technology.

In my current role at Bank of America, I develop automation solutions, analyze and condition mortgage data, and collaborate with QA, Compliance, Operational Risk, and Technology teams to ensure reliable, high-quality data for testing and lower-level environments. My work focuses on improving data integrity, supporting audit readiness, and streamlining manual processes through automation.

One of my key accomplishments has been designing and implementing an automated full-payment posting solution using Java, Eclipse IDE, and Cucumber for Mortgage, HELOC, and HELOAN products, helping reduce manual effort while improving accuracy and consistency.

My technical background includes Java, SQL, Python, Git, Jira, REST APIs, React, Node.js, Spring Boot, and test automation. I also have experience with mortgage platforms and enterprise data management tools including DataX, Passport, SARGE, HLMS, LOCRO, HLRS, ICE, and UiPath.

Before transitioning into software engineering, I worked as a Registered Nurse, where I developed strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, regulatory compliance, and cross-functional communication skills. This unique combination of healthcare and technology experience allows me to approach complex problems with both technical expertise and a customer-focused mindset.

I am passionate about data quality, automation, continuous improvement, and building solutions that make processes more efficient. I am open to fully remote opportunities in Test Data Management, Data Quality, Data Governance, Business Systems, and Technology Operations.

positions.title: Software Engineer I
positions.description:
Designed and implemented an automated full-payment posting solution using Java, Eclipse IDE, and Cucumber for Mortgage, HELOC, and HELOAN transactions.
* Perform test data mining, validation, conditioning, and provisioning to support QA testing across Banking & Lending Technology.
* Analyze and resolve data quality issues while improving integrity, completeness, and audit readiness.
* Collaborate with QA, Compliance, Operational Risk, and Technology teams to deliver reliable test data solutions.
* Utilize Microsoft SQL, Oracle SQL, Jira, Passport, DataX, and enterprise mortgage platforms.
* Translate business requirements into technical solutions that improve efficiency and reduce manual effort.

positions.title: Coding Apprentice
positions.description:
* Completed an intensive full-stack software engineering apprenticeship focused on enterprise software development and Agile methodologies.
* Built full-stack web applications using Java, JavaScript, React, Node.js, HTML, CSS, and SQL.
* Developed RESTful APIs and backend services while integrating relational databases.
* Collaborated with cross-functional teams using Agile/Scrum practices, participating in sprint planning, code reviews, and debugging sessions.
* Utilized Git and GitHub for version control and continuous collaboration.
* Strengthened problem-solving, software testing, and application development skills through hands-on projects.

positions.title: Registered Nurse
positions.description:
Delivered high-quality, patient-centered care in a fast-paced Neuro/Cardiac Medical-Surgical unit.
* Maintained accurate clinical documentation using Epic EMR while ensuring compliance with healthcare regulations and documentation standards.
* Collaborated with physicians, case managers, therapists, and multidisciplinary teams to coordinate patient care and improve outcomes.
* Prioritized multiple high-acuity patients while demonstrating strong critical thinking, communication, and decision-making skills.
* Supported quality improvement initiatives by maintaining accurate clinical records and adhering to patient safety standards.
* Educated patients and families on treatment plans, medications, and discharge instructions.
positions.insights: Microsoft Teams, Microsoft Word and +3 skills
